question: Which Barcelona midfielder moved to Juventus in 2020 in an accounting swap deal worth €72m (with €10m add-ons) in exchange for Miralem Pjanić?
hints: A Brazilian central midfielder signed from Grêmio in 2018.
He later spent an injury-hit loan spell at Liverpool in 2022–23.
He revived his form on loan at Fiorentina in 2023–24.
explanation: Barcelona and Juventus executed a 2020 swap valuing Arthur Melo at €72m (plus €10m add-ons) and Miralem Pjanić at €60m.

question: Which Italian club did Rodrigo De Paul spend five seasons at (2016–2021) before joining Atlético Madrid for €35m?
hints: He wore their number 10 shirt and club captain's armband.
They are based in Friuli-Venezia Giulia.
He scored 34 goals in 184 appearances for them after leaving Valencia.
explanation: Atlético Madrid signed Rodrigo De Paul from Udinese for €35m in July 2021 just days after he lifted the Copa América.

question: Which English club sold Dejan Lovren, Adam Lallana, Rickie Lambert, Nathaniel Clyne, Sadio Mané, and Virgil van Dijk to Liverpool between 2014 and 2018?
hints: Their academy also produced Gareth Bale and Luke Shaw.
Total fees received from Liverpool across those six deals exceeded £175m.
They play at St Mary's Stadium.
explanation: Liverpool signed six key first-team players from Southampton between 2014 and January 2018, culminating in the £75m arrival of Virgil van Dijk.

question: Which club sold both Kevin De Bruyne (in 2014) and Mohamed Salah (in 2016) permanently before either reached their Ballon d'Or contender peaks?
hints: José Mourinho oversaw both sales.
De Bruyne left for £18m and Salah left for around £12m.
Both players later won Premier League Golden Boots or Playmaker awards against them.
explanation: Chelsea sold Kevin De Bruyne to Wolfsburg in January 2014 and Mohamed Salah to Roma in 2016 after brief spells at Stamford Bridge.

question: Which club did Brighton & Hove Albion sign Moisés Caicedo from for roughly £4.5m in February 2021?
hints: An Ecuadorian club famous for its youth academy.
They also produced Piero Hincapié and Kendry Páez.
Brighton sold Caicedo to Chelsea two and a half years later for £115m.
explanation: Brighton scouted Moisés Caicedo directly from Ecuadorian side Independiente del Valle for around £4.5m in February 2021 before selling him for £115m.

question: How much did Swansea City pay Rayo Vallecano to sign Michu in July 2012?
hints: It is widely regarded as one of the greatest Premier League bargains of the 2010s.
Rayo Vallecano were experiencing financial trouble at the time.
He scored 18 league goals in his debut season — roughly £111k per goal.
explanation: Michael Laudrup signed Michu for Swansea City in July 2012 for just £2 million, and the Spaniard netted 22 goals in all competitions that season.

question: Which player moved from Arsenal to Manchester United in a direct swap deal with Henrikh Mkhitaryan in January 2018?
hints: No transfer fee changed hands in the straight swap.
He was unveiled playing 'Glory, Glory Man United' on a piano.
He scored just 5 goals in 45 appearances at Old Trafford.
explanation: Alexis Sánchez joined Manchester United in January 2018 with Henrikh Mkhitaryan heading to Arsenal in a straight swap with zero cash fee.

question: Which striker joined Leicester City from non-league Fleetwood Town for £1 million in May 2012?
hints: It was a record transfer fee for a non-league player at the time.
He had previously played for Stocksbridge Park Steels and FC Halifax Town.
Four years later he won the Premier League and FWA Footballer of the Year.
explanation: Leicester City paid Fleetwood Town £1m (rising with add-ons) for Jamie Vardy in May 2012, setting a non-league transfer record.

question: Which club sold Andy Robertson to Liverpool for an initial £8 million in July 2017?
hints: They had just been relegated from the Premier League.
Kevin Stewart moved in the opposite direction as part of the summer business.
Robertson had joined them from Dundee United in 2014.
explanation: Liverpool signed Scottish left-back Andy Robertson from relegated Hull City for £8m rising to £10m in July 2017.

question: Which defender became the first £50 million full-back in football history when he joined Manchester City in July 2017?
hints: Signed from Tottenham Hotspur.
Benjamin Mendy arrived at the same club later that same summer for £52m.
He won six Premier League titles under Pep Guardiola.
explanation: Manchester City signed Kyle Walker from Tottenham for £45m rising to £50m in July 2017, briefly making him the world's most expensive defender.

question: In August 2020, which Chelsea winger moved across London to Arsenal on a free transfer?
hints: A Brazilian international who had spent seven years at Stamford Bridge.
He assisted twice on his Arsenal debut against Fulham before scoring just once all season.
He later returned to Corinthians and starred for Fulham.
explanation: Willian left Chelsea as a free agent in August 2020 to sign a three-year contract with Arsenal, though he terminated it a year later.

question: Which club paid Bayern Munich €30 million in 2014 to sign Toni Kroos with one year remaining on his contract?
hints: The deal was completed right after Germany won the 2014 World Cup.
Widely regarded as one of the biggest bargains of the modern era.
He won five Champions Leagues across a decade at the Bernabéu.
explanation: Real Madrid signed Toni Kroos from Bayern Munich for roughly €25m–€30m in July 2014, where he anchored their midfield for 10 years.

question: Which goalkeeper became the world's most expensive stopper when Chelsea paid his €80 million (£71.6m) release clause in August 2018?
hints: He was signed from Athletic Bilbao.
His transfer came weeks after Alisson had briefly held the world record at £66.8m.
He later spent 2023–24 on loan at Real Madrid.
explanation: Chelsea triggered Kepa Arrizabalaga's €80m Athletic Bilbao release clause in August 2018 to replace Thibaut Courtois.

question: Which club received €222 million from PSG when Neymar Jr's release clause was triggered in August 2017?
hints: They used the windfall to sign Ousmane Dembélé and Philippe Coutinho.
It remains more than double the previous world transfer record.
He formed the 'MSN' trio there.
explanation: PSG paid Neymar's €222m buyout clause to FC Barcelona in August 2017, shattering the world transfer record.

question: Which Danish midfielder did Brentford sign on a six-month free transfer in January 2022 following his recovery from cardiac arrest at Euro 2020?
hints: He had mutually terminated his contract with Inter Milan because Serie A rules forbid playing with an ICD.
He transformed Brentford's season before joining Manchester United that summer.
Previously starred for Ajax and Tottenham.
explanation: Brentford signed Christian Eriksen on a free transfer in January 2022, helping him make a triumphant Premier League return before moving to Man United.

question: Which forward moved from Borussia Dortmund to Bayern Munich on a Bosman free transfer in July 2014?
hints: Unlike Mario Götze (€37m) and Mats Hummels (€35m), his move cost €0 in transfer fees.
He agreed the pre-contract in January 2014.
He went on to score 344 goals in 375 appearances in Munich.
explanation: Robert Lewandowski ran down his Dortmund contract to join Bayern Munich on a free transfer in July 2014.

question: Which club sold Riyad Mahrez to Leicester City in January 2014 for roughly £400,000?
hints: A famous French Ligue 2 academy club that also developed Paul Pogba and Dimitri Payet.
Mahrez admitted he initially thought Leicester was a rugby club.
They play in Normandy.
explanation: Leicester City scout Steve Walsh signed Riyad Mahrez from French Ligue 2 side Le Havre in January 2014 for around £400,000.

question: Which Brazilian midfielder moved from Liverpool to Barcelona in January 2018 for an initial £105 million (rising to £142m)?
hints: Liverpool reinvested the fee in Virgil van Dijk and Alisson Becker.
He later scored twice against Barcelona while on loan at Bayern Munich in an 8–2 win.
Joined Aston Villa in 2022.
explanation: FC Barcelona signed Philippe Coutinho from Liverpool for £105m rising to £142m in January 2018, the third-highest transfer fee ever paid.

question: Which club did Real Madrid sign Eduardo Camavinga from on deadline day in August 2021 for €31 million?
hints: He made his Ligue 1 debut for them at age 16.
The Breton club also developed Ousmane Dembélé and Raphinha.
He won the Champions League in his debut season in Madrid.
explanation: Real Madrid signed 18-year-old Eduardo Camavinga from Rennes on deadline day in August 2021 for €31m plus add-ons.

question: Which Georgian winger joined Napoli from Dinamo Batumi for roughly €10 million in July 2022?
hints: He briefly returned home from Rubin Kazan before moving to Italy.
He was crowned Serie A MVP in his debut 2022–23 season.
Napoli fans nicknamed him 'Kvaradona'.
explanation: Napoli signed Khvicha Kvaratskhelia for around €10m in 2022, and his 12 goals and 13 assists propelled them to a first Scudetto in 33 years.

question: Which defender did Leicester City sell to Manchester United for £80 million in August 2019, setting a world record for a defender?
hints: Leicester had bought him from Hull City for £17m two years earlier.
The fee surpassed the £75m paid for Virgil van Dijk.
He was named club captain five months after arriving.
explanation: Manchester United paid Leicester City £80m for Harry Maguire in August 2019, breaking Virgil van Dijk's transfer record for a defender.

question: Which club sold Bruno Fernandes to Manchester United in January 2020 for €55 million plus add-ons?
hints: He had returned to Portugal from Sampdoria in 2017.
He won two consecutive Liga NOS Player of the Year awards there.
They play at the Estádio José Alvalade.
explanation: Sporting CP sold captain Bruno Fernandes to Manchester United in January 2020 after he scored 63 goals in 137 games in Lisbon.

question: Which German club signed Jude Bellingham from Birmingham City in July 2020 for £25 million?
hints: Birmingham City retired his #22 shirt upon his departure at age 17.
They also developed Jadon Sancho and Christian Pulisic.
They sold him to Real Madrid three years later for €103m.
explanation: Borussia Dortmund won the race for 17-year-old Jude Bellingham in 2020, beating Manchester United to his signature.

question: Which Uruguayan midfielder joined Arsenal from Sampdoria in July 2018 for £26 million?
hints: A tenacious 1.66m defensive midfielder.
He scored in a 4–2 North London Derby victory over Tottenham in December 2018.
Later won La Liga on loan at Atlético Madrid before moving to Galatasaray.
explanation: Lucas Torreira joined Unai Emery's Arsenal from Sampdoria in 2018 for £26m after impressing at the World Cup in Russia.

question: Which player joined Juventus on a free transfer from PSG in 2019 before returning to France with Marseille in 2024?
hints: A tall left-footed French central midfielder.
He won the 2019–20 Scudetto and 2021 & 2024 Coppa Italia in Turin.
He started France's 2022 World Cup final.
explanation: Adrien Rabiot joined Juventus on a free transfer in July 2019, making 212 appearances over five seasons before signing for Marseille in 2024.

question: Which club sold Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang to Arsenal in January 2018 for a then-club-record £56 million?
hints: He won the 2016–17 Bundesliga Torjägerkanone with 31 goals there.
He formed a prolific strike partnership with Henrikh Mkhitaryan and Marco Reus.
Olivier Giroud left Arsenal for Chelsea on the same deadline day.
explanation: Arsenal broke their transfer record at £56m to sign Gabon striker Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang from Borussia Dortmund in January 2018.

question: Which centre-back did Real Madrid sign on free transfers in consecutive summers — David Alaba (2021) and who in 2022?
hints: A German international arriving from Chelsea.
He won the 2020–21 UEFA Champions League under Thomas Tuchel.
He converted the winning penalty in Madrid's 2024 UCL shootout at Manchester City.
explanation: Real Madrid signed Antonio Rüdiger on a Bosman free transfer from Chelsea in June 2022, one year after landing David Alaba the same way.

question: Which Dutch defender joined Liverpool from Southampton in January 2018 for £75 million?
hints: Previously played for Groningen and Celtic.
Scored on his Liverpool debut against Everton in the FA Cup.
Finished runner-up for the 2019 Ballon d'Or.
explanation: Liverpool paid Southampton £75m in January 2018 for Virgil van Dijk, briefly a world-record fee for a defender.

question: Which Spanish full-back moved from Real Madrid to Tottenham in September 2020 with a €45m buy-back clause after winning the Europa League on loan at Sevilla?
hints: He was voted La Liga's best left-back during Sevilla's 2019–20 campaign.
Later had loan spells at Atlético Madrid, Manchester United, and Brentford.
Born in Collado Villalba.
explanation: Tottenham signed Sergio Reguilón from Real Madrid for £25m in September 2020 after he starred in Sevilla's 2020 Europa League triumph.

question: Which striker became West Ham United's club-record £45 million signing from Eintracht Frankfurt in July 2019?
hints: He later scored 11 goals in a single Champions League group/knockout campaign for Ajax (2021–22).
He overcame testicular cancer to score the winning goal in the 2023 AFCON final.
Ivorian international.
explanation: West Ham broke their transfer record at £45m for Sébastien Haller in 2019 before he went on to shine at Ajax, Dortmund, and Ivory Coast.
